summary: The material is clearly written with a strong action-first structure and defined terms; one minor gap remains in the emergency-escalation guidance.

findings.title: Emergency escalation path could be clearer
findings.explanation_plain: The material gives a number to call but not a simple rule for choosing which one to use.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence distinguishing when to call the doctor versus 112.
findings.evidence: Call your doctor right away, or call 112 if you feel very unwell.

findings.title: Support contact hours not given
findings.explanation_plain: The material does not say when the support line is staffed.
findings.recommendation: State the support line's opening hours.
findings.evidence: Our support line is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

instrument_items.rationale: NSAID is explained with an example on first use.
instrument_items.evidence: Painkillers like ibuprofen (a "NSAID") can stop your tablets from working well.

instrument_items.rationale: Specialized terms are explained at first use.

positive_observations: Leads with the single most important instruction, in bold, before anything else.
